sentences.text:
Author: M. Ganga Rao
Bench: M.Ganga Rao
 Honourabale Sri Justice M. Ganga Rao
 Criminal Petition No.1916 of 2020
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioners/A-1 to A-5 under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, seeking to quash the proceedings in Crime No.183 of 2020 of Jangareddygudem Police Station, West Godavari District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 269, 270, 271 read with Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 22 of Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 and Section 59 (i) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Jangareddygudem Police Station, West Godavari District
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Cigarettes and other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Heard Sri M. Karibasaiah, learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel agree that the subject matter of the Criminal Petition is squarely covered by the judgment of this Court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2019 and batch, dated 18-12-2019.

Considering the submission made by both the counsel and following the judgment of this court in Criminal Petition No.5421 of 2018 and batch, dated 18-12-2019, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners in F.I.R.No.183 of 2020 of Jangareddygudem Police Station,
West Godavari District.
Therefore, this Criminal Petition is dismissed.
